title: GNX tools.json
description: Buttons in the settings window's DEBUG > TOOLS menu, and keybinds. Modding guide section 17.

Adds food.

Adds orbs.

Plays a vanilla sound (sfx_type, not type).

category.description: A TOOLS entry: buttons, or sub-menus (categories). Without label the game errors.

toggle.description: Makes it an ON/OFF button; the save-state key that stores ON or OFF.

key.description: F1-F12, A-Z (capitals), 0-9 (number row), space, tab, escape, or the range "0-9".

action_per_key.description: One action for "0-9"; its value is replaced with the pressed digit (so "{key}" is fine there).

popup_template.description: Message for "0-9"; the first {key} becomes the digit.
